parentId.title: Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer — Article 1: Definitions
parentId.publisher: UNEP Ozone Secretariat (the Protocol's own text)
parentId.states: For the purposes of this Protocol: "Convention" means the Vienna Convention for the Protection of the Ozone Layer, adopted on 22 March 1985.

montreal.review: The seed leaves the parent null because the Protocol's long name does not name its convention. Its Article 1 does, in the text the Ozone Secretariat — the treaty's own secretariat — publishes. The pinned Wikipedia revision the seed cites for this record (1375917408) was read first: it names the Vienna Convention only as the 1985 framework, never as the Protocol's parent, so it is not the citation.
